definitions.explanation: Having met someone in person and being able to recognize them. Almost always used with ある or ない to indicate whether one knows someone personally.

examples.japanese: {面識|めんしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was introduced by someone I already knew.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{面識|めんしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It is said that the victim and the suspect did not know each other personally.

notes:
Almost always appears in the patterns {面識|めんしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to know someone personally) and {面識|めんしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to not know someone personally). Rarely used outside these fixed patterns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {面識|めんしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to be personally acquainted with)
- {面識|めんしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to not know someone personally)
- {面識|めんしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a person one knows)

USAGE:
This is a somewhat formal word frequently seen in news reports and police contexts. In casual speech, ⟦{知|し}り{合|あ}い→知り合い：03253_shiriai⟧ (acquaintance) or ⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have met before) are more natural.
